title: Module 1 Final Challenge: Calculator
instructions: Implement a simple calculator program that initializes two numbers and calculates their sum, difference, product, and quotient. Print all four results.
steps: Initialize two variables, `num1` and `num2`, with any numeric values.
Calculate the sum and store it in `sum_result`.
Calculate the difference and store it in `difference_result`.
Calculate the product and store it in `product_result`.
Calculate the quotient using standard division (`/`) and store it in `quotient_result`.
